nonBlockingNotes: Spec Validation commands reference tests/v21-md-companion.test.ts (singular) but actual file is tests/v21-md-companions.test.ts (plural); criterion Command: in charter.md would fail verbatim.
validateNarrativePath() does not reject '../' traversal at schema level; only the import-time validateNarrativeCompanionPath() blocks it. Consistent with lazy-check design but worth noting.
No test covers JSON-only evidence (missing sibling .md); spec says it is valid; implementation handles it correctly but test coverage for that path is absent.
summary: All five spec requirements (optional relative narrativePath, absolute rejection, outside-dir rejection, deep-dir round-trip, both qa.md and review.md) verified by code inspection and 6/6 tests green.
because: Code reading confirms schema optional field on all four evidence kinds, correct relative-path validation logic, and sibling auto-detection for both qa and review kinds. Test suite runs 6 pass 0 fail with 17 assertions.
